Subject: Throughput prep & dedicated sizing sync

Hi Asha / Acme infra team —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can hit the sizing call prepared: 

- What we heard: you’re evaluating dedicated capacity to support a near-real-time feature in your control plane (user-facing inference for telemetry enrichment).
- Key asks from your side: predictable tail latency, cost visibility, and data isolation for logs.

Can you confirm the following before we do the sizing session? (answers help us pick the right machine types and batching strategy.)
1) Target throughput: sustained requests/sec and expected peak bursts (e.g., 500 rps sustained, 1,500 rps burst).
2) Latency SLO: p50/p95 targets for a typical request (including average token length or token budget).
3) Model and payload: model family (open Llama3-70B / internal finetune / other) and average prompt + completion token counts.
4) Any network constraints or egress limits we should know about (VPC peering, proxy, private endpoints).

I’ve attached a short capacity workbook (capacity_workbook.xlsx) and put a shared folder with a short prep checklist here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d_capacity_docs. If you can pre-fill the workbook with a couple of representative traffic samples, it saves us a round of back-and-forth.

Proposed sizing session: 45 minutes — technical deep dive + preliminary sizing. My team’s availability (PT): 
- Wed Aug 12, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed Aug 12, 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Thu Aug 13, 9:00–9:45am PT

Please confirm what works and we’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda. I’ll bring Vivek (inference lead) and Marissa (solutions) to cover runtime configuration and cost tradeoffs.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: capacity_workbook.xlsx
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@acmecloud.com>

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput prep & dedicated sizing sync

Thanks Jordan — helpful recap.

Quick answers below (high level). We can provide more exact logs once Ravi (our infra lead) drops the export into the shared folder.

- Target throughput: ~500 req/s sustained during business hours; expected peak bursts up to ~1,800 req/s for short windows (30–90s).
- Latency SLO: aiming for p95 < 120 ms for an average request (our typical prompt+completion ~300 tokens total). p50 target ~35–45 ms.
- Model: we plan to test with Llama3-70B-quant first (open), then a finetune later if perf is good.
- Network: VPC peering to Redwood Private expected; there’s an egress proxy on the path with MTU 1400.

We can meet Wed Aug 12 at 10:00am PT — Ravi (ravi.kumar@acmecloud.com) will join. I’ve asked him to upload the network diagram and a small sample of traffic (CSV) to your shared folder before the call.

Thanks — Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Product, Acme Cloud Services
asha.patel@acmecloud.com

- 15 min: Sizing options and expected costs (Vivek/Marissa)
